editorial_notes: The final source sentence reverses the ring arrow: the asserted smooth map is B_n to A_n, as in all preceding definitions, not A_n to B_n.
The source calls the associated graded rings Rees algebras; the displayed direct sums of successive quotients are the actual objects used.
The affine reduction sentence saying V-prime_n to W-prime_n is smooth means at the selected point before shrinking; the following sentence explicitly states the need for one common neighbourhood.
